Clay Loam.advice_en: Clay loam holds moisture well. Irrigate when top 5 cm feels dry — typically every 5–7 days in active growth.
Clay Loam.advice_ta: Clay loam moisture retain pannum. Mel 5 cm dry-aa irundha thanneer — active growth-la 5–7 naal ku oru murai.

Clay.advice_en: Heavy clay drains slowly — avoid over-irrigation. Water deeply but less often (every 7–10 days).
Clay.advice_ta: Heavy clay slow-aa drain aagum — athigam thanneer avoid pannunga. 7–10 naal ku oru murai deep irrigation.

Loam.advice_en: Loam balances drainage and retention — irrigate every 4–6 days during tillering/flowering.
Loam.advice_ta: Loam balanced-aa irukku — tillering/flowering-la 4–6 naal ku oru murai paayichu.

Sandy Loam.advice_en: Sandy loam dries quickly — shorter intervals (every 3–4 days), lighter but frequent irrigation.
Sandy Loam.advice_ta: Sandy loam seekiram dry aagum — 3–4 naal ku oru murai, konjam konjam frequent irrigation.

Alluvial.advice_en: Alluvial soils are fertile — maintain 25–30% moisture; irrigate every 5–6 days if no rain.
Alluvial.advice_ta: Alluvial soil fertile — 25–30% moisture maintain pannunga; mazhai illana 5–6 naal ku oru murai.

Red Soil.advice_en: Red soil needs organic matter and frequent light irrigation (every 4–5 days) in dry spells.
Red Soil.advice_ta: Red soil-ku organic matter + 4–5 naal ku oru murai light irrigation thevai.

Black Cotton Soil.advice_en: Black cotton soil cracks when dry — avoid long gaps; irrigate every 6–8 days with moderate depth.
Black Cotton Soil.advice_ta: Black cotton soil dry-aa crack aagum — 6–8 naal ku oru murai moderate depth irrigation.

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Keep beds moist, 2–3 cm shallow water
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Nursery bed moist-aa vechukonga, 2–3 cm shallow water

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Maintain 2–5 cm standing water if canal-fed wetland
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Canal wetland-na 2–5 cm standing water maintain pannunga

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Alternate wetting and drying — irrigate when cracks appear
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Alternate wetting/drying — crack varum podhu thanneer

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Critical stage — never allow moisture stress; shallow flood
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Critical stage — moisture stress avoid; shallow flood vechukonga
Stable moisture maintain; sudden drainage avoid

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Gradually reduce water 10–15 days before harvest
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Harvest munadi 10–15 naal thanneer gradually reduce pannunga

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Light irrigation at pegging/flowering if no rain
Rain-fed preferred; one supplemental if dry spell >10 days
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Rain-fed best; 10 naal dry-aa irundha oru supplemental irrigation

irrigation_schedules.method_en: One critical irrigation at flowering if rain fails
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Flowering-la mazhai fail aana oru critical irrigation

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Heavy crop — weekly irrigation 60 mm or furrow irrigation
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Heavy crop — varam ku oru murai 60 mm or furrow irrigation

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Light irrigation every 4 days after sowing; avoid waterlogging in seedlings
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Sowing apram 4 naal ku oru murai light irrigation; seedling-la waterlogging avoid pannunga

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Light irrigation every 4 days after sowing; keep soil moist not flooded
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Sowing apram 4 naal ku oru murai light irrigation; soil moist-aa vechukonga

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Vegetative stage — irrigate every 6 days if no rain
irrigation_schedules.method_ta: Vegetative stage — mazhai illana 6 naal ku oru murai

irrigation_schedules.method_en: Square formation and flowering need timely irrigation

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Urea 50 kg/ha top-dress + MOP 25 kg/ha if K low
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: Urea 50 kg/ha top-dress + K kammi-na MOP 25 kg/ha
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: Apply with standing water or just before irrigation
fertilizer_schedules.timing_ta: Standing water-oda or irrigation munadi apply pannunga

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Urea 30 kg/ha last split if N deficient
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: N kammi-na Urea 30 kg/ha last split
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: Before panicle initiation — moisture must be adequate
fertilizer_schedules.timing_ta: Panicle initiation munadi — moisture adequate-aa irukanum

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Split N in 2 doses; add DAP 20 kg/ha if P < 15
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: N 2 dose-la split; P < 15-na DAP 20 kg/ha
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: First dose at tillering, second at PI if needed
fertilizer_schedules.timing_ta: Tillering-la first dose, PI-la second dose

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Gypsum 200 kg/ha at pegging + DAP if P low
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: Pegging-la gypsum 200 kg/ha + P kammi-na DAP

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Basal DAP 40 kg/ha + urea 20 kg/ha top-dress
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: Basal DAP 40 kg/ha + urea 20 kg/ha top-dress
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: Basal at sowing, top-dress at branching

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Urea + MOP split across tillering months
fertilizer_schedules.product_ta: Tillering months-la Urea + MOP split pannunga
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: Monthly splits for 3 months from planting

fertilizer_schedules.product_en: Urea 25 kg/ha + MOP 15 kg/ha at square formation
fertilizer_schedules.timing_en: Apply with irrigation; avoid excess N late season
fertilizer_schedules.timing_ta: Irrigation-oda apply; late season excess N avoid
